description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to authorize the incorporation of the Trustees of the Revival Christian Ministry Trust
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the legal incorporation of a trust under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87). The core subject matter is the creation of a legal entity and the definition of its legal powers and capacities, which falls squarely under the "Legal framework and regulatory matters" category for Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
